dispositions.detail: Mounted pending attempts automatically reconcile by stable initiation ID; manual status check remains. Focused regression applies a service-verified late result once without a simulation click.

Purchase history is refreshed immediately and enriches the stable ledger row with observational status and immutable pack snapshot. New attempts retain captured facts across catalog changes; legacy records omit unknown historical amounts/credits.
Validated saved-source context offers Return to video after non-verified outcomes. Browser trace confirms source/range restoration without a processing action.

Credits writes a one-use account-scoped refresh-credit-quote hint. Task 81 must revalidate, consume, and request a fresh quote. No automatic fresh-quote claim is made before that integration is proven.
Credits uses shared Button medium default with no local shrinking; measured controls are 40px desktop and 48px phone.
History is a responsive labeled definition list. English/Russian phone labels measure 14px/20px and 390px screenshots have no horizontal overflow.
Unknown start IDs persist through remount; repeat click does not start again; after reconciliation reports not-started, retry reuses the identical initiation and operation inputs.
History amount and after-values have explicit labels. Ledger accounting values remain unchanged.
Reserved aggregate is labeled In processing. The English copy explains that credits are held for active processing and are not a final charge; the Russian label is present in the UI evidence.
Covered by the shared Button size role; no Credits-local size override.

contract_semantics.history: LedgerEntry.relatedPurchase is optional observational metadata joined by relatedOperationId. Ledger kind, delta, availableAfter, and reservedAfter remain immutable accounting facts.
contract_semantics.pack_snapshot: New mock attempts persist optional immutable pack facts at initiation and expose them in purchase/history snapshots. Legacy records without a snapshot do not infer historical amounts or credits from current catalog data.
contract_semantics.return_hint_fields: Version 1; intent refresh-credit-quote; accountId, projectId, sourceId, sourceRevision, canonical selection revision/startMs/endMs, optional purchaseId. No volatile project-activity revision match and no invented TTL. Removal is guarded by expected marker.
contract_semantics.return_hint_authority: Session storage is routing intent only. The consuming flow must revalidate through existing services. If the hint-key write fails while the separate project-pointer write succeeds, the original return context is retained for manual quote recovery. Global session-storage denial also blocks the project-pointer write and Return is blocked with the existing warning notice; this is not a navigation-success claim. Neither mode was fault-injected.
